Workflow.Name: Get Dataverse table storage (Entra OBO)
Workflow.Description: Copy of dsr_gettablestorage that ships without an SP-authenticated HTTP action. After solution import, open in Power Automate, delete the raw HTTP action, and replace with 'HTTP with Microsoft Entra ID (preauthorized)' bound to a user with Power Platform admin rights. Used to test whether the per-env /resources licensing endpoint accepts user-identity tokens (SP tokens hit 403 with empty body).
